info.title: Zekurix Server
info.description: Backend REST API for the Zekurix platform.

get.description: Returns the current application health status and version.

200.description: Current application health status and version.

503.description: Application is unhealthy and temporarily unavailable.

get.description: Returns all permissions supported by the server.

post.description: Creates a role with the given name and permission set. Requires the `roles:create` permission. The caller may only grant permissions included in their effective permissions; any requested permission missing from that set causes the request to fail with 403 Forbidden, preventing privilege escalation.

Location.description: URI of the created role resource.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of roles, optionally filtered by exact name. Requires the `roles:read` permission.
Returns the role identified by the provided ID. Requires the `roles:read` permission.

put.description: Replaces the name and permission set of the role identified by the provided ID. Requires the `roles:update` permission. The updated role's permissions must all be included in the caller's effective permissions; otherwise, the request fails with 403 Forbidden, preventing privilege escalation.

delete.description: Deletes the role identified by the provided ID. Requires the `roles:delete` permission.

post.description: Creates a user and returns the created user details. Requires the `users:create` permission.

Location.description: URI of the created user resource.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Requires the `users:read` permission.
Returns the details of the authenticated user.
Returns the details of the specified user. Requires the `users:read` permission unless the authenticated user is retrieving their own details.

delete.description: Removes the specified user from the system. Requires the `users:delete` permission unless the authenticated user is deleting their own account.

get.summary: Retrieve roles assigned to a user.
get.description: Returns the roles assigned to the specified user. Requires the `roles:read` permission unless the authenticated user is retrieving their own roles.

put.summary: Assign a role to a user.
put.description: Assigns the specified role to the user. Requires the `roles:assign` permission. The role's permissions must all be included in the caller's effective permissions; otherwise, the request fails with 403 Forbidden, preventing privilege escalation. Repeating the request has no additional effect.

204.description: Role assigned successfully, or was already assigned.

delete.summary: Unassign a role from a user.
delete.description: Unassigns the specified role from the specified user. Requires the `roles:unassign` permission. This operation is idempotent: if both the user and role exist, a `204 No Content` response is returned even if the role is not assigned to the user.

204.description: Role successfully unassigned from the user, or the assignment did not exist.

get.summary: List permissions granted to a user.
get.description: Returns the effective permissions granted to the specified user through their assigned roles. Requires the `roles:read` permission unless the authenticated user is retrieving their own permissions.

X-Request-Id.name: X-Request-Id
X-Request-Id.description: Optional request correlation identifier. If omitted, the server generates one.

RoleNameFilter.name: name
RoleNameFilter.description: Filter roles by exact role name.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge indicating that a Bearer token is required.

HealthResponse.description: Response returned by the health check endpoint.

status.description:
Current health status of the application:
- `ok`: All components are operating normally.
- `degraded`: One or more components are experiencing issues, but the application remains operational.
- `unhealthy`: One or more critical components prevent the application from operating correctly.

version.description: Current application version following Semantic Versioning (SemVer).

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem.

detail.example: An unexpected internal server error occurred.

instance.description: URI identifying the specific occurrence of the problem.

example.title: Internal Server Error
example.detail: An unexpected internal server error occurred.

Permission.description: A named capability that determines whether an operation is authorized.

NonEmptyPermissionsResponse.description: Response containing all permissions available in the API.

Limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

Offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Offset is zero-based.

Total.description: The total number of items matching the request filters, before applying `limit` and `offset`.

Pagination.description: Pagination metadata for the requested page. `limit` and `offset` contain the values applied to the request. `offset` is zero-based. `total` is the total number of items matching the request filters before applying `limit` and `offset`. When `offset` is greater than or equal to `total`, the returned item collection is empty.

RolesResponse.description: Response containing a paginated list of roles.

RoleRequest.description: Request payload for creating or updating a role.

UsersResponse.description: Response containing a paginated list of users.

Identity.description: External identity uniquely identifying a user.

CreateUserRequest.description: Request payload for creating a user.

RoleSummariesResponse.description: Response containing a list of role summaries.

BadRequest.description: The request syntax is malformed and cannot be processed.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the provided access token is invalid.

InternalServerError.description: An unexpected internal server error occurred.

Forbidden.description: The client is not allowed to perform the requested action.

RoleConflict.description: Another role with this name already exists.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request payload exceeds the maximum accepted size.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request media type is not supported.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is syntactically valid but failed validation.

UserConflict.description: Another user with this identity already exists.

GetRoleById.description: The role identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the getRole operation.

UpdateRoleById.description: The role identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the updateRole operation.

DeleteRoleById.description: The role identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the deleteRole operation.

GetUserById.description: The user identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the getUser operation.

DeleteUserById.description: The user identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the deleteUser operation.

ListUserRolesById.description: The user identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the listUserRoles operation.

ListUserPermissionsById.description: The user identifier returned by this operation can be used as the id parameter of the listUserPermissions operation.
